fix(metrics): only a ledger file actually read counts as a mikro ledger

Re-review of #3125: the collector counted ledger CANDIDATES (own
.mikro/runs/*.jsonl names) as evidence, so a directory named
wish-context.jsonl alone — which readRows correctly skips as EISDIR —
still turned "no ledger here" into a measured 0 attempts / $0 (reproduced
through the real CLI on 1e89eab69).

readRows now returns null for a file it did not read (absent, a directory,
or a failed read), and the repository counts as measured only when at least
one of its own ledger files was actually read: a readable empty file is a
measured 0; EISDIR or vanished candidates alone are no ledger (null); any
other read failure stays unknown as #3125 made it.

Regression: a directory-only ledger → null; a readable empty ledger beside
it → measured 0. Fails on the previous code.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

fixtures.sourceMessage:
fix(self-update): drop macOS platform tokens to match the installer

`scripts/install.sh` stopped mapping Darwin to a darwin-* tarball that
release.yml never publishes, but `src/lib/self-update.ts` still did — so
`brain update` on macOS would resolve `darwin-arm64`, fetch the manifest,
find no sha256 entry and fail on the artifact instead of on the real
cause. The self-update ⇄ install.sh drift tripwire caught it.

PLATFORM_TOKENS is now linux-x64 + linux-arm64 only, and `resolvePlatform`
refuses any `Darwin:*` pair with the shared NO_MACOS_ARTIFACT_MESSAGE at
EXIT_ENV — raised while planning, before any manifest fetch.

The tripwire now pins the removal as the contract: the linux tokens must
match on both sides AND neither file may carry a darwin-* token, while
both must still name macOS in their refusal.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Fable 5.1 <noreply@anthropic.com>
fixtures.prompt: Intent: drop macOS platform tokens to match the installer

feat(mikro): microagent runner, schemas, bench harness and three agent drafts

scripts/mikro/call.ts speaks MCP stdio to `mikro mcp`, validates the JSON an agent
returns against scripts/mikro/schemas.ts, verifies every cited path:line against
the tree, retries once with the errors appended, appends a ledger line under
.mikro/runs/ and posts an AGENT span to Phoenix (cc-mikro). bench.ts runs an
agent over its fixture set (ground truth from merged PRs) and scores it
mechanically. .mikro/ becomes a tracked genie asset (config declares the
custom-typed DeepSeek 4.1 Flash provider; runs/ stays machine-local) with three
agents — issue-triage, wish-context, review-prep — on the upstream five-rules
contract.
